[SWS_DM_00039] Resetting the internal debounce counter upon restarting an
operation cycle
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04068, RS_Diag_04225
⌈
If an operation cycle is restarted, the DM shall reset the internal debounce counter for
all events referenced by
DiagnosticEventToOperationCycleMapping.diag-
nosticEvent
and referencing the restarted operation cycle by
DiagnosticEvent-
ToOperationCycleMapping.diagnosticOperationCycle
.
⌋
